description: Sanitized personal fixtures for nexitally-node-parser.js. Hosts use .example.invalid. Passwords are public placeholders from Quantumult X sample.conf or the word placeholder.

fixtures.title: Nexitally-style full configuration
fixtures.title_zh: 拟真 Nexitally 完整配置
fixtures.notes: Mimics a managed Quantumult X export: DNS, policy, Chinese node names, traffic rows, a [Premium] stub section, a duplicate, and later filter rules. Only the three real AnyTLS nodes survive.
fixtures.notes_zh: 模拟机场完整配置：中文节点名、流量行、[Premium] 分段、重复行。只保留三台真实 AnyTLS。

fixtures.title: Chinese traffic / expiry rows
fixtures.notes: Lines containing 剩余, 流量, 到期, or 套餐 are dropped even when they use a supported protocol prefix.
fixtures.notes_zh: 节点行里只要出现 剩余 / 流量 / 到期 / 套餐 就会被丢掉。

fixtures.title: English traffic / expiry rows
fixtures.notes: Traffic, Expire, Reset, and Days Left are substring matches. Reset also matches inside other words; see reset-substring.
fixtures.notes_zh: Traffic / Expire / Reset / Days Left 是子串匹配。Reset 也会误伤其它单词。

fixtures.title: [Premium] in a tag and as a later section
fixtures.title_zh: 标签里的 [Premium] 与后续分段
fixtures.notes: A server line whose tag contains [Premium] is dropped. A later [Premium] header ends [server_local], so nodes after that header are never seen.
fixtures.notes_zh: tag 含 [Premium] 的行会被丢。后面的 [Premium] 分段会结束 [server_local]。

fixtures.title: Official Quantumult X protocol samples
fixtures.notes: Uncommented lines adapted from crossutility/Quantumult-X sample.conf: AnyTLS, SS2022, VMess, VLESS Reality Vision, Trojan, HTTP, SOCKS5.
fixtures.notes_zh: 改编自官方 sample.conf 的协议行，全部应被保留。

fixtures.title: Unsupported protocol prefixes
fixtures.notes: hysteria2, tuic, wireguard, and ssh are not in the keep list. A following AnyTLS line is kept.
fixtures.notes_zh: hysteria2 / tuic / wireguard / ssh 不在保留列表。

fixtures.title: Three Quantumult X comment styles
fixtures.notes: Official sample.conf treats lines starting with ; # or // as comments. Those prefixes are dropped before protocol matching.
fixtures.notes_zh: 以 ; # // 开头的行按官方规则当注释。

fixtures.title: Duplicates after trim
fixtures.notes: Leading spaces or tabs do not create a second node. Dedup is exact-string after trim.
fixtures.notes_zh: 先 trim 再按整行去重。

fixtures.title: UTF-8 BOM and CRLF
fixtures.notes: Nexitally exports on Windows-style line endings plus a BOM should still parse. The file is stored as binary so Git does not rewrite CRLF.
fixtures.notes_zh: 带 BOM 的 CRLF 文件仍应解析成功。

fixtures.title: Indented [SERVER_LOCAL]
fixtures.title_zh: 缩进且大小写不敏感的分段名
fixtures.notes: The section header is matched case-insensitively and may have leading whitespace.
fixtures.notes_zh: 分段名大小写不敏感，允许前置空白。

fixtures.title: Section runs to end of file
fixtures.notes: No following [section] header is required.
fixtures.notes_zh: 后面可以没有其它分段。

fixtures.title: Later [filter_local] ends the extract
fixtures.notes: A server-shaped line after [filter_local] is not extracted. The parser does not scan the whole file for protocol lines.
fixtures.notes_zh: 分段结束后的节点行不会被提取。

fixtures.title: No [server_local] section
fixtures.notes: A server-only snippet under [server_remote] is the wrong input shape for this parser.
fixtures.notes_zh: 只有 [server_remote] 时会报错。

fixtures.title: Section present but nothing usable
fixtures.title_zh: 有分段但没有可用节点
fixtures.notes: Comments plus an info-node still produce the no-usable-servers error, not an empty resource.
fixtures.notes_zh: 只剩注释和流量行时返回错误，而不是空列表。

fixtures.title: Header without a following newline
fixtures.notes: The extractor requires a newline after [server_local]. A header-only file is treated as missing.
fixtures.notes_zh: 标题后必须有换行，否则视为找不到分段。

fixtures.title: Nodes live under [server_remote]
fixtures.notes: This parser only reads [server_local] from a full configuration.
fixtures.notes_zh: 本解析器只读完整配置里的 [server_local]。

fixtures.title: Tab-indented IPv6 AnyTLS
fixtures.title_zh: Tab 缩进的 IPv6 节点
fixtures.notes: Leading tabs are trimmed. IPv6 literals stay intact.
fixtures.notes_zh: 行首 Tab 会被 trim，IPv6 地址原样保留。

fixtures.title: Only the first [server_local] is read
fixtures.notes: A second [server_local] later in the file is ignored. Managed Nexitally exports normally have one.
fixtures.notes_zh: 文件里若出现第二次 [server_local]，会被忽略。

fixtures.title: Protocol case and spaces before =
fixtures.title_zh: 协议大小写与等号前空格
fixtures.notes: ANYTLS= and ShadowSocks = both match the supported-prefix regex.
fixtures.notes_zh: ANYTLS= 与 ShadowSocks = 都可以匹配。

fixtures.title: Reset matches inside other words
fixtures.notes: The excluded regex is a substring. tag=Preset 01 contains Reset and is dropped. This is documented, not a suggested rename.
fixtures.notes_zh: 排除规则是子串：Preset 含 Reset，会被丢掉。

fixtures.title: Days Left needs the space
fixtures.notes: Days Left is dropped. DaysLeft (no space) is kept. The parser does not try to be a full English NLP filter.
fixtures.notes_zh: Days Left 会被丢，DaysLeft 会保留。

fixtures.title: Policy lines inside [server_local]
fixtures.notes: static= and available= policy definitions are not server prefixes.
fixtures.notes_zh: static= / available= 不是节点行。

fixtures.title: HTTP and SOCKS5 helpers
fixtures.title_zh: HTTP 与 SOCKS5 辅助节点
fixtures.notes: Helper HTTP/SOCKS5 nodes are kept. They are valid Quantumult X server prefixes.
fixtures.notes_zh: HTTP / SOCKS5 辅助节点会保留。

fixtures.title: Preamble text before [server_local]
fixtures.notes: Provider notes, subscription-userinfo comments, and [general] above the section are ignored.
fixtures.notes_zh: 分段之前的说明和 [general] 都会被忽略。
